long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: I need one piece of clay in my paws before I can shape anything, and the clay bank is mine to pick from.
One piece of clay becomes a finished small object at the workbench, and it will be mine to keep.
Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will read about them.

today.reason: I have claimed the workbench and the clay is close by, so making something to keep is the best use of the evening; I will finish with some reading about seeds.
